description.name: Entry
description.text: Twenty single ranged attacks (0.01 each), grants [Astra] and [Regenga] to all allies, grants [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Sazh], [Apex Cold Blood Ability Tracker] and [Apex Cold Blood Level]

description.name: Astra
description.text: Prevents Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Confuse, Slow, Stop, Blind, Sleep, Petrify, Berserk, Sap and Stun once

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Sazh
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Cold Blood (0~2), removed after using Apex Cold Blood two times

description.name: Apex Cold Blood Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Cold Blood level by 1 after using 7 Machinist or Support abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Sazh]

description.name: Apex Cold Blood Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Cold Blood level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Sazh]
